Grow Mask White Blur expands the mask; if too small it won't fully cover the original subject and replacement will show artifacts — try 24–40.

Block_size is the mask block size; too small causes jagged subject edges in the output — try 16–36.

Character replace: replace the person in the video with the reference image person; the video background stays the same.

Motion transfer: copy the motion from the video person onto the image so the image animates.

Only one of these modes can be on at a time; do not enable both.
Tune swap block count from 0–40 based on VRAM and RAM: increase blocks if you OOM on VRAM; decrease if you OOM on system RAM.
If resolution or duration is very high and decoding runs out of memory, enable VAE tiling.

1) If color cast is wrong or the replaced subject color is off, enable the first relight LoRA.
2) Speed LoRA — keep on.
3–4) Reward LoRAs — optional.
5) Bouncy LoRA — you know the vibe; weight 0.6 is already quite bouncy.

Notes on these parameters:

force_rate (forced FPS): enter manually; default is 16 FPS. Use 30 for smoother motion; FPS also affects the frame cap.

frame_load_cap (max frames to load): total frames read — main control for effective clip length.

skip_first_frames: skip this many frames from the start.

select_every_nth (stride): read every Nth frame (frame skipping / subsampling).
